Key content: Mapping Australian Data Centres: Australia is emerging as a key location in the global build out of hyperscale compute capacity. Strong governance, land, renewable energy pipelines as well as proximity to large Asian markets make the case for hyperscaler investment.  This Data Centres Transparency Project aims to make legible the data and governance context shaping this 'super cycle' build out. It is designed as a recursive, self-reflective 'living atlas' that uses AI-informed intelligence and tools to monitor and observe the evolving terrain to inform community knowledge.
